subject: Literature
subcategory: The Art of the Short Story
title: O. Henry and the Surprise Finale
description: A micro-lesson that makes O. Henry and the Surprise Finale usable.

hook.text: O. Henry wrote his most famous stories while serving time in prison for embezzlement from a Texas bank.

buildup.text: The Gift of the Magi tells of a couple who each sell their most prized possession to buy a gift for the other.

discovery.text: She sells her hair to buy him a watch chain. He sells his watch to buy her hair combs. Both gifts become useless.

twist.text: O. Henry adopted his pen name in prison. His real name was William Sydney Porter, a convicted felon.

climax.text: His twist endings became so iconic that the annual O. Henry Prize is still awarded for outstanding short fiction.

punchline.text: A convict invented the twist ending that bears his pen name.

quiz.question: What irony defines The Gift of the Magi?
options: The couple never exchanges gifts at all
Each sells their prized possession to buy a gift for the other, making both gifts useless
One partner's gift is far more expensive than the other's
